Resource Allocation

Allocate CMI activities, resources and dates first; the Delivery Plan updates automatically from these allocations.

Detailed CMI Activity Allocation

Add the relevant activity or activities to each CMI, then allocate site/off-site resources and dates to every activity.
CMI activity workflow: choose an activity and click Add, then assign the relevant site and/or off-site resource and planned start/target dates. As soon as an activity has a resource and valid dates, it is synchronised automatically to the Delivery Plan. Save CMI Activity Plan remains as a validation check that every selected activity is complete.

Progress Update

Update only CMIs already included in the Delivery Plan.
Submission rule: when Delivery Status is changed to Submitted to Client, the entered Delivery Value is automatically copied to CMI Register → Submitted Value, the register status changes to Submitted, and Submitted Date is populated if blank. Reopening: a CMI previously marked Completed can be reopened; it returns to In Progress, the Finish Date is cleared, and it is removed from completed counts until completed again.

Data Review & Control Notes

Items affecting prioritisation and planning quality.

Data quality observations

Control rules

Zero-value treatment: $0.00 in Initial Estimate or Submitted Value is treated as blank for statuses other than Agreed and Submitted.
Priority: High ≥ $30,000; Medium ≥ $5,000 and < $30,000; Low < $5,000; blank = Unvalued.
Multi-line CMIs: repeated CMI references remain separate work items because scope lines can have different statuses and values.
Persistence: standalone edits are stored in this browser. Export Backup JSON before moving devices/browsers.
